Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class PrivilegedRunner

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.PrivilegedRunner
public final class PrivilegedRunner extends Object
Runs commands with elevated privileges through pkexec (polkit), reporting a structured result so callers can tell "succeeded" apart from "the user dismissed the authentication dialog" and "polkit is unavailable".

Used by the control center's user-management panel (useradd/usermod/ userdel/gpasswd/passwd/chage) and by the task manager to signal processes owned by other users. Everything degrades gracefully: if pkexec is not installed, run(List) returns PrivilegedRunner.Status.UNAVAILABLE rather than throwing, and the UI can switch to read-only.

No JNI/JNA; this only shells out to pkexec via ProcessRunner.

      public static PrivilegedRunner.PrivilegedResult run(List<String> command, String stdin, Consumer<String> lineSink)
      Runs the given command with elevated privileges via pkexec, forwarding every stdout line to lineSink as it arrives (on the gobbler thread) so callers can render live progress while the polkit prompt and the command run.
      Parameters:
      command - the command and arguments (without a leading pkexec)
      stdin - text to feed to the command's stdin, or null for none
      lineSink - optional per-stdout-line callback (null = buffer only)
      Returns:
      a structured PrivilegedRunner.PrivilegedResult; never null
